statuses.confirmed: May enter core when object identity/provenance are adequate.
statuses.proposed: Retain outside core unless project inclusion policy explicitly supports candidate partition.
statuses.cm_like: Do not count as core CM.
statuses.disputed: Preserve competing source positions; do not resolve by database fiat.
statuses.rejected: Retain audit trail when historically relevant.
statuses.unresolved: Await evidence; do not create pseudo-record.

snapshot_rule: Every corpus-size statement must name its source snapshot/date and inclusion policy.
